body.citation: de Aguas, J., S. Krumscheid, J. Pensar, and G. Biele (2025), ``The Probability of Tiered Benefit: Partial Identification with Robust and Stable Inference,'' Proceedings of Machine Learning Research 275, 1--24, 4th Conference on Causal Learning and Reasoning, arXiv:2502.10049. Proposition 5 and equations (7)--(8) give sharp bounds without outcome monotonicity for tiered benefit; the paper defines tiered harm by reversing improvement across ordered outcome categories and reports the corresponding bounds.
